pages.text:
The Upgrades tab has one slot for each upgrade type the machine supports. Empty slots show a faded icon of the matching upgrade and accept only that type, up to 8. Machines without supported upgrades have no Upgrades tab.
- Speed: works up to 16x faster at 8, using power or fuel just as much faster.
- Energy: FE per operation x 0.8 for each (down to 17% at 8).
- Heat: more heat from each fuel, or more FE from each HU.
- Range: widens the Tree Cutter's area by a block on each side.
- Insulation: goes in a Heat Cell to slow its heat leak.
Only the upgrades a machine can use fit in its slots. Picked up with the Wrench, a machine keeps its upgrades; broken, it drops them.
